claim: Across MBPP, HumanEval, BigCodeBench, and LiveCodeBench, 114 tasks were identified that six advanced LLMs (Claude Sonnet-4, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3-Coder, GPT-4o, Llama-3.3-70B, Mistral-3.2-24B) consistently fail, and static solution-code complexity alone does not explain these failures.
stance_target: sources of systematic, cross-model code-generation failure
quoted_support: Interestingly, complexity alone did not fully account for these failures, suggesting that additional factors play a significant role.

claim: Consistently-failed code generation tasks fall into four recurring qualitative failure patterns: wrong problem mapping, flawed/incomplete algorithm design, edge case mishandling, and formatting mistakes.
scope_conditions: manual inspection of 114 consistently-failed tasks across 4 benchmarks
quoted_support: we identified four recurring failure patterns: wrong problem mapping, flawed or incomplete algorithm design, edge case mishandling, and formatting mistakes.
